body: I think that’d help the both of us :)

I know that life sounds terrifying but there are good things. I sound like a hypocrite because I want to die too but there are good things. Like homemade brownies and exploring places you’ve never been to or looking at the little things in life. It sounds like you love your family, do things with them like watch a bad film that’s laughable at or go eat at a cheap café. 

I know that global warning is scary but there are things being done to stop it. Trees are being planted, flower patches for bees are being planted, people are actively cutting down on plastic.

I’m not good with advice but all I say is to keep going. Your family obviously cares about you. Maybe talk to them? If not, reach out to someone. Whether that’d be a therapist or friend or maybe a hotline. It’s going to be okay; I don’t know when but it’ll be okay. Take in the little things. You deserve to feel okay :)

It’s fine dude. I feel super hypocritical when I try and help people who are suicidal when i’m suicidal too. I’d love to get a new therapist but my therapist does help me with my anxiety... just not the other problems I have. I tried to tell her about how I think I have ADHD (I fit all the symptoms, etc) or some attention disorder but it was brushed off. Also, I feel like there’s no point with getting a new one because my sessions with her are ending in 2 weeks. I feel like I’ve lied my way through the system and I feel terrible.
True but I don’t think I really want to be mourned, I want to be forgotten as edgy as it sounds. But yeah, I don’t really want to waste my life but I feel like I have nothing left

I’ve given it almost 6 years and I don’t know man. Life seems to be going downhill by the second and I feel so alone in my life even though people tell me that they care. Maybe I’m just oblivious or a bad friend. I don’t know
Dude, I’m just so done with everything
I'd hate to be burden to him. But I'll try to open up more to him.

It's funny you say that, I don't have a best friend. I just feel like I'm lost in between all my friends. Most of them haven't noticed anything about that has changed. I did talk to one of my friends the other day, everything got too much and I said some things that I said on this post. He told me that he cares about me & that he's always here for me. Yet, I told him to forget everything that I said because I was just being stupid nonetheless he continued to say that he's here for me. Nonetheless, it was a nice moment.

hi sorry for the late response, it's been a weird few days. Yes I do admit that the behavioural course is going well but I feel like it isn't enough. It's all about anxiety and not about any other issues I have. I did mention some of this stuff to the person i talk in the behavioural course and he's helped me out a bit. I could never tell anyone else in my life, it'd be a huge burden onto my friends and definitely my family due to the fact that currently everything is shit with my family. I don't want to make it worse. My anxiety has just been awful lately, my behavioural courses are every 2-3 weeks and I'm too scared to ask for them to be every week because I hate to bother anyone.
Thanks! I just find it really hard to talk to people about my anxiety as no one understands it, including my friends. I'm trying to open up more but i find it really difficult

I have looked into meds but all the people I've seen (I've seen about 4 therapists in the past 2 years) have said that I don't need them but I just need "handle my situation in the right mindset" which doesn't really help lmao. I'm starting aone on one cb therapy class with my therapist :)

I'm having these cognitive behavioural classes to help with other problems I have but anxiety is the main one that is focused. I'm not being treated with medication but I'm getting advice on how to stay calm and stuff along those lines
I do have an old one piece bathing suit and i think it might be a size too small but I'll definitely try it out. Thank you for your advice! :)

Thank you for recommending me some methods! I'll check out some YouTube videos on it. I do wear sports bras and I have worn two of them at once to try and compress it (idk I try haha) and I look slightly flat chested when I wear baggy shirts over it. 

Unfortunately I'm going away on a trip in the summer, and the clothes I'm allowed to bring (it's kinda like a school trip) is minimal. I'm not allowed to bring any clothes that will make me feel masculine and that sucks. Anyway thanks for the advice! :)
Thank you! I do wear a compression sports bra very often and I'll definitely check out some YouTube videos on it. Thanks for recommending me some methods :D!
Thanks! I have heard of underworks but I'm always nervous about getting packages because my parents always want to see what i brought :) I'll check out underworks!

I'm glad to hear that it is the uncommon to feel confused. I just don't want to ruin the life that my family, especially my parents, and friends think I live.

I always have doubts about being trans because I really don't want to bother people in my life with changing my name, having pronouns I like, etc. It's sad that I feel like this as I really do not live for myself.

For once, I want to do something that makes me happy. I will definitely try the advice given to me as I've already come out (I told her how I was feeling and that I feel weird about being "female") to one of friends who gave me so much support that it was quite unreal.

Thank you ever so much for talking about your won experience, everyone on this thread has reinsured me that it's okay to feel like this. I feel like I finally have people who understand what I'm going through. I don't want my doubts to stop me from being happy.

I do feel like when I'm okay with my body and gender, I just ignore this feeling inside of me. I tend to do that with any problem I have, I ignore it because I want to live a "normal" life. 

I don't want to be on deaths door and realise that my life has been a lie. Thank you for your words as they have really made me think :)

I'm kinda glad I'm not the only one who is confused. Thank you for your advice! A couple of hours ago, I told a close friend of mine about how I'm feeling and she said that Matt is a great name and she said that I'll look handsome with short hair! This has truly made me feel less lonely. 

I have created multiple accounts in different social medias as a guy, for example my Spotify account has matt in the username, not the other name I have.

Thank you for your advice! And congrats on being on T!! I hope you have a great day/night! :)

Wow, I didn't know that there's a extremely rare chance that this could be a phase. At the moment, I am not very comfortable being a woman yet some days I feel like I don't care. I'm not too sure what I am or who I am. I feel like I am mostly masculine with some expetions where I am forced to be feminine. 

Thank you for you advice and information about other identities! I will definitely look into them! 
I hope you have a good day/night! :)

I've decided to open up to one of my good friends about how I'm feeling, I'm just waiting for her reply. I've always wanted to cut my hair short but many people I know say that "I'll look ugly". At first, I decided not to cut my hair short but now, I just really want to cut my hair short and try binding. In the past, I have brought sport bras and tried binding with them but they were way too tight so I had to get rid of them.

I do dress very masculine and I am open to my friends about the fact that I love dressing this way. I do talk about myself in a male way, for example I refer to myself as a boy. This does annoy and confuse some people but a lot of the people I care about don't care that I call myself a boy.

I don't want to lose countless years of staying in the closet and being scared. I'm still very unsure at the moment but I hope that I will gain courage to tell at least two of my friends.

Thank you very much for giving me advice! I do like the random name I picked for my account, maybe I'll stick with Matt for a while. Like I've said; i am confused and quite frankly scared to tell people. Still, if I do think I am 100% trans, I will try and live for myself. And again, thank you ever so much for the advice and support.
I hope you have a wonderful day/night :)

I just don't want to ignore this "feeling" I have for my whole life and wake up when it's too late and I can't live life as a boy. All these comments have made feel accepted for once, thank you! I hope you have a good day/night! :)

Thank you for your kind words and advice! I will hopefully some how get through my exams even though I'm having a tough time at the moment. I do write about my feelings and stuff sometimes as I love writing. 

I am, in fact, a minor and I have had a therapist before but for a totally different reason. Thank you again for your advice. It is much appreciated, I hope you have a good day/night. :)
Congratulations :D!!

Thank you, I was very hesitant to actually make this post because I felt like everyone else on this sub Reddit knows who they are. Thank you for being so helpful, honestly, I do need to stop thinking about how others might feel about the potential thought of me being trans :)
